caption: The video captures a wide, tranquil landscape in which a rugged tan-and-brown mountain ridge rises above a calm, dark lake. Small patches of snow cling to the upper-left summit, while the slope shows dry grass and shadowed gullies. The entire ridge is mirrored almost perfectly in the still water filling the lower half of the frame, the reflection reading as a continuous inverted silhouette rather than a second range. In the lower-left foreground, green coniferous trees sit beside a band of pale, dry grass, and a bright patch of overcast sky reflects off the water at the bottom right. Throughout the clip, the framing, ridge outline, foreground trees and grass band stay largely aligned, with no obvious camera pan or tilt. The lake surface reads as glassy, the mirror reflection holding together with little visible ripple or distortion. No object enters or exits the scene, and the bright sky-reflection patch keeps roughly the same shape.
